minecraft:written_book_content.title: The Seven Vows
minecraft:written_book_content.author: A Prior
pages: {"text":"Seven alcoves. Seven vows. None of the names were written down."}
{"text":"The central altar was built last. The builders refused to enter the nave after sunset."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. The settlement's well stones carry this mark. Its final inventory lists seven missing people, though the village had only six houses."}
